items: The music stays in one dreamy key all run, its tunes now 8-bar melodies in a 32-bar shape: an instrument's tune, a sung answer, the tune again, a sung ending
The melodies are mostly slow, with long notes and triplets
Each 32 bars runs four-on-the-floor, four-on-the-floor, breakbeats, then a breakdown
A singing voice now carries half of every melody
The tempo stays at 120 all run, 5 faster each time you're knocked down, and every knockdown brings new tunes
